name: AeroBook Pro 14
shortDescription: A 14-inch ultraportable with a 12-hour battery and a fanless design.
description: The AeroBook Pro 14 pairs a fanless aluminum chassis with all-day battery life, making it the pick for developers and writers who work away from a desk. The 14-inch display keeps the footprint small without cramping the keyboard.

name: ForgeBook X15
shortDescription: A 15-inch performance laptop built for creative workloads.
description: ForgeBook X15 is tuned for video editing and 3D work, with a high-refresh display and a cooling system that keeps sustained loads quiet. Ships with a full-size SD card reader for creators on the move.

name: Slimline Air 13
shortDescription: The lightest laptop in the lineup, built for students on a budget.
description: Slimline Air 13 trims weight and price without cutting the essentials: a crisp 13-inch panel, a comfortable keyboard, and enough battery to get through a full school day.

name: WavePod ANC Earbuds
shortDescription: True wireless earbuds with adaptive active noise cancellation.
description: WavePod earbuds combine adaptive ANC with a compact charging case that adds three extra full charges. Touch controls handle playback, calls, and noise-cancellation toggling.

name: Resonate Over-Ear Studio
shortDescription: Studio-tuned over-ear headphones for mixing and critical listening.
description: Resonate Studio headphones use a flat frequency response tuned for mixing engineers, paired with plush memory-foam cushions for multi-hour sessions.

name: BoomCube Mini Speaker
shortDescription: A pocketable Bluetooth speaker with surprisingly deep bass.
description: BoomCube fits in a jacket pocket but still fills a room, thanks to a passive bass radiator and a rugged, water-resistant shell built for outdoor use.

name: Pulse Fit Watch 2
shortDescription: A fitness-first smartwatch with round-the-clock heart-rate tracking.
description: Pulse Fit Watch 2 tracks heart rate, sleep, and over 40 workout types, with a battery that lasts up to 7 days on a single charge and always-on display support.

name: Ridgeline Tracker Band
shortDescription: A minimalist fitness band with a two-week battery life.
description: The Tracker Band strips away the extras and focuses on step counting, sleep tracking, and notifications, stretched across a battery that lasts two full weeks.

name: Aurora Smart Ring
shortDescription: A titanium smart ring that tracks sleep and recovery discreetly.
description: Aurora packs sleep-stage tracking, temperature sensing, and recovery scoring into a scratch-resistant titanium band designed to be worn 24/7.

name: NovaPhone 15
shortDescription: A flagship phone with a triple-camera system and all-day battery.
description: NovaPhone 15 pairs a 120Hz OLED display with a triple-camera system built around a large main sensor, plus a battery tuned to comfortably last a full day of heavy use.

name: Ridgeline Flex Fold
shortDescription: A foldable phone that opens into a compact tablet.
description: Flex Fold unfolds into a 7.6-inch tablet display for multitasking, then folds down to pocket size, backed by a reinforced hinge rated for 200,000 folds.

name: Pulseline Lite 5G
shortDescription: An affordable 5G phone with a clean software experience.
description: Pulseline Lite 5G covers the essentials well: a bright 90Hz display, dependable battery life, and near-stock software that stays out of your way.

name: Lumaxis X Mirrorless
shortDescription: A full-frame mirrorless camera built for enthusiasts and hybrid shooters.
description: The Lumaxis X pairs a 33MP full-frame sensor with in-body stabilization and 6K video, aimed at photographers who also shoot serious video.

name: Lumaxis Compact G2
shortDescription: A pocketable compact camera with a fast fixed lens.
description: Compact G2 is built for street and travel photography, with a fast f/1.8 fixed lens and a body small enough to carry everywhere.

name: SkyView Action Cam 4
shortDescription: A rugged, waterproof action camera with 5.3K stabilized video.
description: SkyView Action Cam 4 shoots stabilized 5.3K footage and survives drops, dust, and water down to 10 meters without a housing.

name: GridCharge 100W GaN
shortDescription: A compact 100W GaN charger with three ports for laptops and phones.
description: GridCharge fits a laptop-capable 100W charger into a housing the size of a standard phone charger, with three ports that share power intelligently.

name: KeyForge Mechanical TKL
shortDescription: A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches.
description: KeyForge TKL drops the number pad to save desk space and ships with hot-swappable sockets, so switches can be changed without a soldering iron.

name: GlidePoint Wireless Mouse
shortDescription: A lightweight wireless mouse tuned for long editing sessions.
description: GlidePoint weighs in under 80 grams and pairs a low-latency 2.4GHz connection with a battery that lasts up to 70 days on a single charge.
